dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Done? Did you adjust the lens and check the lighting? Make sure the focal length was properly set? Let me check...

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Wow, you actually nailed everything! ...A shot like this is front-page quality.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Next interview, I'm definitely bringing you along. Imagine the amazing shots we could take together!

choices.text: About the Xiao Lantern I released...

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: I know, I saw it already! I'd launched a whole bunch earlier. It was the perfect photo op!

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Wishes? What... HAH!? I was so busy taking photos, I forgot to write any! Shoot, and I released so many... Does that mean my wishes aren't gonna count...?

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: And a very merry Lantern Rite to you too! Oh, hang on, that doesn't sound quite right... Whatever, have lots of fun!
